description: This file defines the FileStorageService class responsible for storing, retrieving, and deleting files from a specified directory in a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: FileStorageService
classes.description: Service class for managing file storage operations including storing, loading, and deleting files.

methods.name: FileStorageService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the storage directory, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores an uploaded MultipartFile to the configured directory and returns its path as a string.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a file as a Resource given its filename.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all files in the storage directory and recreates it.
